title: potentilla pensylvanica f. longepilosa
intro: Potentilla pensylvanica f. longepilosa, commonly known as Pennsylvania cinquefoil, is a flowering plant species native to North America. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to soothe and calm the digestive system, as well as its potential to protect against oxidative stress and microbial infections. Bioactive constituents of Potentilla pensylvanica f. longepilosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
